A LITTLE ABOUT CAFE BRINDAVAN

Good cups.Great company.

Cafe Brindavan is a welcoming neighbourhood café for chai lovers, coffee people and everyone who enjoys a tasty bite. Drop in for a quick refresh, catch up with friends or simply make an ordinary day feel special.

“Every cup has a little comfort. Every visit has room for one more conversation.”

THE BRINDAVAN PAIRING

A cup of chai. A plate of happiness.

Pair your favourite brew with a puff, bun, sandwich or biscuit. Simple café treats, made for everyday moments.

OUR PROMISE

Simple pleasures. Good moments.

A friendly café atmosphere, comforting drinks and quick bites worth coming back for.

100% Estate Single Origin

Our brand story is built around Indian tea and coffee origins, presented with a contemporary café ritual.

Zero Synthetic Essences

Whole spices and natural ingredients take centre stage in the recipes we present.

Whole Spices

Chai spices are prepared fresh for a more aromatic, expressive brew.
